doc.title: Gerald Wiggins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 2, 1995

title: First arrival in Los Angeles in 1940
summary: The warm Christmas weather won him over, though he went back to New York before settling in L.A.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: And you’ve been in L.A. for how long? A long time?

Well like I said I first got out here in 1940, but I didn’t stay then. But the weather got to me. It was Christmas Day and a hundred degrees here, and in New York is was like ice, snow, and everything else. I immediately called my mother and said I found God’s country, don’t look for me in New York anymore. I went back naturally but when I got a chance to settle here I did.
